notes.title: Halloween Update 1.0.8 + New Game Mode
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
First of all thanks for playing and giving us feedback.

We're happy to offer you a new game mode !
Of course like every new content, it's free.

You can now have access to daily challenge and new hidden secrets specially for Halloween!
We've also added new decorations for your Halloween night with your friends! 

Hope you'll enjoy it!

We also want to thanks some streamers all arround the world for showing up the game, here's a compilation of their best moment!


[previewyoutube=th1-spoLwAA;full][/previewyoutube]
